maddeler.e:
ننفرد (form VII)
# نَنْفَرِدُ (nanfaridu) /nan.fa.ri.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْفَرَدَ (infarada)
# نَنْفَرِدَ (nanfarida) /nan.fa.ri.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَرَدَ (infarada)
# نَنْفَرِدْ (nanfarid) /nan.fa.rid/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْفَرَدَ (infarada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
